Appearance move to sidebar hide From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Pop culture award show held in 1993 19th People's Choice Awards Date March 9, 1993 Location Universal Studios Hollywood , Universal City, California Hosted by John Ritter and Jane Seymour Television/radio coverage Network CBS ← 18th · People's Choice Awards · 20th → The 19th People's Choice Awards , honoring the best in popular culture for 1992, were held on March 9, 1993, at Universal Studios Hollywood , in Universal City, California . They were hosted by John Ritter and Jane Seymour , and broadcast on CBS . Special tributes were paid to both Knots Landing and Cheers for their long runs on television.
